Engine Arena uses the unmodified LibreHardwareMonitorLib 0.9.6 NuGet package.
Upstream: https://github.com/LibreHardwareMonitor/LibreHardwareMonitor/tree/v0.9.6
The corresponding pinned upstream source archive, MPL 2.0 license and third-party notices are included here.
The signed PawnIO driver is installed separately from https://pawnio.eu/ with user approval; it is not included in this portable distribution.
